name: Isole Eolie (Aeolian Islands)
description: Seven volcanic islands rise from the Tyrrhenian Sea just north of Sicily, named after Aeolus, mythical ruler of the winds. Lipari is the largest, while Stromboli and Vulcano are known for their eruptions. Scientists have studied them since the 18th century, and two eruption types, Strombolian and Vulcanian, take their names from them. Today they are a popular summer destination.
